items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown; authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days, not complete TLS safety. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. No incident or exploit signal is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of absence. Risk severity: high for public exposure or security-sensitive release; medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: preserve private and preview-only launch gates, block security-sensitive releases, and continue only existing read-only evidence capture and containment work. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not request duplicate telemetry or create duplicate work.
